sentences.en: I received a five hundred dollar advance on my pay.
sentences.zh: 我领到了五百美元的预付款。

sentences.en: I want him to be informed about that in advance.
sentences.zh: 我想在他知道这件事之前先通知他。

sentences.en: The advance reviews of the new film are very favorable.
sentences.zh: 新电影的提前评价非常积极。
